findings.title: Keep the registered metric alert handler instantiable
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of its abstract members: counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. It remains registered as MetricAlertFire.detector_handler, so accessing detector.detector_handler for a metric_alert_fire detector now raises TypeError when the property instantiates it. Previously this handler could be instantiated and safely returned no results. This also aborts process_detectors rather than skipping the unimplemented detector. Keep a concrete no-op handler returning an empty dict until the stateful methods are implemented, or implement the required members before registering this class.
